lines: The host and founder Sean Rad discuss how Tinder transformed social discovery by designing an intuitive mobile interface that mitigated the psychological anxiety of rejection.
Scaling the platform required a disciplined, college-by-college expansion strategy that prioritized local network density over broad, unfocused mass marketing.
The team maintained focus by fostering a culture of radical honesty, openly debating product decisions and quickly killing underperforming features like the "Matchmaker" tool.
title: Replay: From Swipe to Scale: How Tinder Became #1 (2024)
